_README: Adapter for the SMOKE-TEST FIXTURE TARGET (issue #64, Phase 2 of #11). A minimal consumer-shaped repo the smoke harness (.claude/self/smoke-fanout.sh) stages into a temp git repo and drives end-to-end: worktree -> canned diff -> these gates via the real gate.sh -> merge. Gates are node-only so they run in a bare environment.

modules.name: fixture-core
modules.description: The fixture's only module. Smoke 'implementer' diffs must stay inside this path — the harness asserts it.
